headline: A solution- and people-oriented engineer — at home in both the support queue and the data pipeline.
summary: Data and Applications Support Engineer working mainly on the Azure stack, with Terraform for infrastructure as code and some experience of Google Cloud Platform. I work with SQL — including serverless SQL — and integrate it into Power BI reports. On the application side I own issues end to end: from the user's report, through log-level debugging and error-code analysis, to raising the work item and shipping the fix myself with AI-assisted coding.
personal: I grew up sharing my home with three people with developmental disabilities, who taught me everything from patience to gratitude — qualities that make me a good colleague, teammate and friend. My time as a personal care assistant in particular sharpened my sense of when to be a friend, when to be a colleague, and when to simply be the fly on the wall.
